SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ABS(e_score)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(e_score)) + SUM(ABS(i_score)), 0), 1), 50.0) AS eAvg, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ABS(i_score)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(e_score)) + SUM(ABS(i_score)), 0), 1), 50.0) AS iAvg, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ABS(s_score)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(s_score)) + SUM(ABS(n_score)), 0), 1), 50.0) AS sAvg, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ABS(n_score)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(s_score)) + SUM(ABS(n_score)), 0), 1), 50.0) AS nAvg, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ABS(t_score)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(t_score)) + SUM(ABS(f_score)), 0), 1), 50.0) AS tAvg, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ABS(f_score)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(t_score)) + SUM(ABS(f_score)), 0), 1), 50.0) AS fAvg, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ABS(j_score)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(j_score)) + SUM(ABS(p_score)), 0), 1), 50.0) AS jAvg, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ABS(p_score)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ABS(j_score)) + SUM(ABS(p_score)), 0), 1), 50.0) AS pAvg FROM test_results
